correctness.rationale: For all real Banach X of dimension ≥2, the Gao–Lau isosceles representation gives sup over unit x⊥_I y of ||x+y|| equals J(X). originality.rationale: The proposed J2=J1 formula is a direct, two-line corollary of two already published results: the October 4 Resultary J1(X)=J(X)/(1+J(X)) and the standard Gao–Lau isosceles representation J(X)=sup_{x⊥_I y}||x+y||, explicitly restated in September 2026 Axioms Lemma 1. The broader established relations imply the final numerical equality without new mathematics even though no source uses identical J2 wording. Therefore the alleged independent new theorem does not survive the implication-based originality standard.
residual_risks: The source literature might not state the literal J2 name in a single theorem; rejection is on complete mathematical implication by prior results, not on a falsely claimed identical title.
Does not contest correctness of the identity itself.
